amrap_test / used: none / progress: custom(misses: 0) {~
  if (amraps[ns]) {
    var.extra = completedReps[ns] - reps[ns]
    if (var.extra > 0) {
      var.bump = rm1 * 0.01 * var.extra
      if (var.bump < 3.34kg) {
        var.bump = 3.34kg
      }
      rm1 += var.bump
    }
    if (completedReps[ns] < reps[ns]) {
      state.misses += 1
    } else {
      state.misses = 0
    }
    if (state.misses >= 2) {
      rm1 = rm1 * 0.9
      state.misses = 0
    }
  }
~}

Pull Up, Band | Pull Up / 3x5 20s, 2x5 120s / 55kg / warmup: none / superset: A / progress: custom(step: 2, target: 15, bw: 95kg) {~
  if (exerciseVariationIndex == 1) {
    if (completedReps >= reps) {
      state.step += 1
      if (state.step == 2) {
        weights = state.bw - 40kg
      } else if (state.step == 3) {
        weights = state.bw - 20kg
      } else {
        exerciseVariationIndex = 2
        weights = 0kg
        numberOfSets = 3
        reps = 5
        state.target = 15
      }
    }
  } else {
    var.total = sum(completedReps)
    if (var.total >= state.target) {
      if (var.total >= 25) {
        weights += 2.5kg
        state.target = 15
      } else {
        state.target = var.total + 2 > 25 ? 25 : var.total + 2
      }
      numberOfSets = ceil(state.target / 5)
      if (numberOfSets >= 4) {
        timers[4] = 120
      }
      if (numberOfSets >= 5) {
        timers[5] = 120
      }
      var.rem = state.target
      reps[1] = var.rem > 5 ? 5 : var.rem
      var.rem = var.rem - 5
      if (numberOfSets >= 2) {
        reps[2] = var.rem > 5 ? 5 : var.rem
        var.rem = var.rem - 5
      }
      if (numberOfSets >= 3) {
        reps[3] = var.rem > 5 ? 5 : var.rem
        var.rem = var.rem - 5
      }
      if (numberOfSets >= 4) {
        reps[4] = var.rem > 5 ? 5 : var.rem
        var.rem = var.rem - 5
      }
      if (numberOfSets >= 5) {
        reps[5] = var.rem > 5 ? 5 : var.rem
      }
    }
  }
~}
